title: Formation Axiom System: Dimensional-Structural Describability — Reproducibility Package
description: Standard-library Python reproduction and proof-audit companion for the finite constructions in Formation Axiom System: Dimensional-Structural Describability. The package reconstructs the one-point and D2 witnesses, the synthetic indexed 3 x 3 witness, a non-injective finite-sum composition witness, and the reported counts 768, 1536, 387, 62, and 127. General set-theoretic proofs remain in the manuscript.
